correctness.rationale: An independent ten-orbit lower bound, complete 64-edge-choice reduction and 24-case directed BEST/matrix-tree calculation give 544 cyclic tours. Separate direct enumeration of all 1,048,576 rooted DNA words gives 5,440 satisfying roots and 544 distinct least rotations; both verifiers pass from embedded artifact paths. Reverse-complement pairing and an order-16 Burnside calculation give 272 and 37, with 31 size-16 and 6 size-8 orbits. The assertion is finite, exact and explicitly circular.

originality.rationale: The 2013 primary work establishes minimum length ten and explicitly asks for enumeration of distinct optima. The 2023 canonical k-mer representation result addresses construction/minimization for general sets, not this exact census. value.rationale: The 2013 paper explicitly presents enumeration of optimal RC-complete sequences as an open mathematical objective. This first even-order DNA instance determines the full set of 544 shortest designs, the 272 distinct double-stranded circular designs, and 37 biological-alphabet symmetry types. These exact non-implied quantities are useful for design variation and evaluating further constraints, not merely a tiny numerical bound.
